import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { settlementKindOf, settlementLabel } from "../../src/resolvers/settlement-kind";

describe("settlement classification (real signature, reachable returns)", () => {
  test("a refusal without a retry is labelled unsettled", () => {
    expect(settlementKindOf({ kind: "refused" })?.kind).toBe("refused");
    expect(settlementLabel({ kind: "refused" })).toBe("unsettled");
  });
});
